title: Ambulatory transportation
heading: A little support. More independence.
summary: Transportation for passengers who walk independently or use a cane or walker.
detail: Share any walking aids, steps or boarding assistance needs when requesting a ride. The team can then confirm whether the vehicle and available support fit your trip.
question: Can I travel with a cane or walker?
answer: Tell the team which mobility aid you use and what assistance you need so they can confirm a suitable ride.

title: Wheelchair transportation
heading: Your mobility. Our attention.
summary: Accessible transportation arranged around your wheelchair and assistance needs.
detail: Include your wheelchair type, pickup access and any assistance requirements. The team must confirm vehicle compatibility and pickup arrangements before accepting the ride.
question: What details are needed for wheelchair transportation?
answer: Share your wheelchair type, pickup and destination addresses, appointment time and access conditions so the team can check suitability.

title: Hospital discharges
heading: The next chapter starts at home.
summary: Transportation from the hospital to home or an agreed care destination.
detail: Coordinate your request with the discharge team. Share the expected ready time, destination, mobility needs and contact person; discharge readiness and ride availability must be confirmed.
question: Can a family member arrange a discharge ride?
answer: A family member or facility coordinator can request transportation and provide the pickup, destination and assistance details for review.

title: Doctor appointments
heading: Make room for your health.
summary: Non-emergency rides to scheduled medical visits and outpatient appointments.
detail: Provide the time you need to arrive, not just the appointment start time. Discuss return transportation and any companion or mobility needs when requesting your trip.
question: What time should I request pickup?
answer: Share your required arrival time and both addresses. The team can review travel time and boarding needs before confirming pickup.

title: Dialysis transportation
heading: Support for the routine that matters.
summary: Transportation requests for dialysis visits, including recurring appointment schedules.
detail: Share treatment days, arrival times and expected return arrangements. Each recurring schedule needs team confirmation; changes in appointment times or assistance needs should be communicated.
question: Can I request recurring dialysis rides?
answer: Yes. Provide your appointment pattern and transportation requirements so the team can review a recurring schedule and confirm availability.

title: Rehabilitation appointments
heading: Keep moving toward your goals.
summary: Rides to physical therapy, rehabilitation and other scheduled recovery appointments.
detail: Let the team know about walking aids, boarding needs and changes in mobility. Transportation supports getting to appointments; therapy and treatment remain with your healthcare professionals.
question: Can transportation be arranged for repeated therapy visits?
answer: Provide the dates, required arrival times and mobility needs so the team can review your schedule and suitable transportation.

title: Assisted living and nursing facility transportation
heading: Care continues between destinations.
summary: Coordinated transportation for assisted living and nursing facility residents.
detail: Facility staff or families can share resident transportation needs, pickup access, appointment details and the receiving contact. Confirm handoff responsibilities and return arrangements with the team.
question: Can a facility coordinate transportation for a resident?
answer: Yes. A facility coordinator can provide trip details and assistance needs for the transportation team to review.
